blocking_unknowns: Real-world incident rate for the open prompt-injection concern at full rollout scale is unknown
Long-run behaviour of agent-suggested code quality as model version updates is not established
distrusted_assumption: Assumed attrition-risk reduction from improved engineer experience: 1-2 percentage points off the current 14% annual voluntary attrition rate, based on the pilot exit survey's stated preference for continued access.

key_reasons.text: The current pilot scope did not exercise the agent against systems handling regulated customer data, leaving open security questions that must be addressed before scaling.
There is no agreed methodology for attributing observed cycle-time or defect-rate changes at enterprise scale specifically to agent usage versus concurrent process changes.
The pilot's adoption rate and conditions do not fully generalize to a full-scale rollout, with weaker onboarding support expected to reduce active usage rates.
